description: Soy docente de Matemática, Física y Tecnología, apasionado por la robótica, la inteligencia artificial y la exploración espacial. Nuestro equipo desarrollará TerraSpace RD, un proyecto que busca identificar lugares de República Dominicana similares a entornos de la Luna y Marte, vinculando la investigación con el futuro puerto espacial de Pedernales. Buscamos participantes creativos con habilidades en programación, análisis de datos, ciencias, diseño y trabajo en equipo. ¡Únete a esta misión!
summary:
TerraSpace Explorer RD is an interactive web application developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Our project identifies and explores potential terrestrial analog sites in the Dominican Republic that share geological, topographical, and environmental characteristics with regions of the Moon and Mars.

The application features interactive maps, images, scientific information, and planetary comparisons of seven selected locations, including Lake Enriquillo, the Baní Dunes, and Valle Nuevo. Using NASA's open data, we aim to highlight similarities, differences, and potential applications for space exploration research.

Inspired by the proposed spaceport in Pedernales, our project seeks to promote scientific innovation, STEM education, and aerospace research in the Dominican Republic.

TerraSpace Explorer RD connects Dominican landscapes with the future of lunar and Martian exploration.
details:
TerraSpace Explorer RD

Project Details — NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026

1. Project Description

TerraSpace Explorer RD is an interactive web application developed to identify, visualize, and compare potential terrestrial analog sites in the Dominican Republic with environments found on the Moon and Mars.

Our project addresses the NASA Space Apps Challenge by investigating locations that could contribute to planetary exploration research, robotic testing, and the scientific study of extraterrestrial environments.

The project is inspired by the Dominican Republic's geographical diversity and the proposed commercial spaceport in Pedernales, which represents a strategic opportunity to encourage aerospace research and technological development in the country.

2. How Does the Application Work?

Our application allows users to explore seven selected locations in the Dominican Republic:

  1. Lake Enriquillo
  2. Baní Dunes
  3. Cave of Wonders (Cueva de las Maravillas)
  4. Valle Nuevo
  5. Cabo Rojo
  6. Los Haitises National Park
  7. Volcanic tunnel caves, included as a proposed category requiring further geological verification

Through an interactive interface, users can:

  • Explore interactive maps: locate potential terrestrial analog sites in the Dominican Republic.
  • Discover each location: access images, geographical information, and geological characteristics.
  • Compare planetary environments: examine similarities and differences between Dominican landscapes and selected regions of the Moon and Mars.
  • Analyze scientific information: consult available data related to terrain, geology, elevation, and environmental conditions.
  • Access scientific references: explore information supported by NASA's publicly available resources.

The comparisons focus on identifying potential similarities rather than claiming that these locations have already been scientifically validated as planetary analogs.

3. Benefits and Expected Impact

TerraSpace Explorer RD seeks to promote scientific research, technological innovation, and STEM education in the Dominican Republic.

Our application provides an accessible educational resource for students, teachers, researchers, and space exploration enthusiasts.

It also highlights the scientific potential of Dominican landscapes and encourages young people to explore opportunities in planetary science, robotics, programming, and aerospace technology.

Additionally, the proposed spaceport in Pedernales serves as a strategic motivation for studying local environments that could support future scientific research and technology testing.

4. Technology and Development Tools

TerraSpace Explorer RD was developed using Visual Studio Code and Codex AI, incorporating artificial intelligence into the software development process.

These tools supported the creation, organization, and improvement of our interactive web application, including its interface, geographical visualization, and planetary comparison features.

The project integrates scientific information and references from NASA's open-data resources to support the exploration and comparison of terrestrial and extraterrestrial environments.

The use of AI-assisted development helped our team transform a scientific challenge into an interactive digital educational solution.

5. Innovation and Creativity

The main innovation of TerraSpace Explorer RD is its focus on identifying potential planetary analogs within the Dominican Republic, a Caribbean country with diverse geological and geographical environments.

While traditional terrestrial analog research has frequently focused on locations such as the Atacama Desert in Chile, Haughton Crater in Canada, and Death Valley in the United States, our application explores additional candidates in the Caribbean.

Our project combines interactive geographic exploration, planetary comparisons, scientific information, and AI-assisted software development into a single platform.

This approach makes planetary exploration more accessible while encouraging scientific curiosity and research in locations that have received less attention as potential analogs.

6. Scientific Considerations

Our team considered several important factors:

  • Geological and topographical characteristics of each location.
  • Environmental similarities and differences between Earth, the Moon, and Mars.
  • Availability and reliability of scientific information.
  • Potential applications for robotic exploration and technology testing.
  • Limitations of using terrestrial environments to represent extraterrestrial conditions.

We recognize that visual similarities alone do not establish scientific equivalence. Additional measurements and geological verification are needed to validate the proposed analogs.

7. Future Development

Our future goals include:

  • Expanding the database with additional potential terrestrial analog sites.
  • Incorporating more quantitative measurements from NASA satellite datasets.
  • Improving the scientific comparison of planetary environments.
  • Developing virtual simulations for robotic exploration.
  • Promoting STEM education and future research collaborations.

Our Vision

"Today we explore Dominican landscapes; tomorrow they could help us explore other worlds."

TerraSpace Explorer RD aims to connect the Dominican Republic with the future of lunar and Martian exploration through science, technology, and innovation.
